lead.event: Indonesia and European Union sign IEU-CEPA and Investment Protection Agreement
lead.headline: Indonesia and EU sign IEU-CEPA and IPA, with zero EU tariffs on 90.4% of lines
lead.blurb: Under the agreements, Indonesia secured duty-free quotas of 1.9 million tons for crude palm oil and 140,000 tons for palm oil products, rising to a peak in year nine, plus EU protection for 72 Indonesian geographical indications. Tariffs will also be cut on another 8.37% of lines, bringing EU tariff elimination or reductions to 98.3% of Indonesia’s tariff lines and 96.31% of export value. Entry into force is targeted for 1 January 2027, subject to ratification and domestic legal procedures.

macro_flows.event: Rupiah falls to a record low against the US dollar
macro_flows.headline: Rupiah hits record low at Rp18,270 per US dollar
macro_flows.blurb: Currency and commodity observer Ibrahim Assuaibi forecasts the rupiah will trade between Rp18,270 and Rp18,320 per US dollar next week. The JISDOR rate closed at Rp18,278, while the spot rate fell 0.09% on the day and 0.35% for the week.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: SMGR, XLSmart, and Elnusa announce share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SMGR, EXCL and ELSA announce buybacks as EXCL budgets Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Semen Indonesia allocated Rp250 billion for a three-month buyback from 20 November, capped at 20% of its placed and paid-up capital. XLSmart’s Rp1 trillion plan runs from 23 November to 22 February 2027, while Elnusa allocated Rp84.5 billion for a buyback from 20 November to 19 February 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: UOB Kay Hian estimates Alamtri Resources dividend payout
earnings_guidance.headline: UOB Kay Hian estimates ADRO dividend after US$517m nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Alamtri Resources earned US$517 million in net profit through September, up 71% year on year and equal to 72% of UOB Kay Hian’s full-year forecast. Its aluminium subsidiary contributed US$70 million to third-quarter profit.
